subject: How to perform action on tab click?

messages.author: 24e378928ea36cc0
messages.subject: How to perform action on tab click?
parts:
I have a shiny app with two tabs; one for a table, and one for a graph. Currently, users have to click on a "Graph" button to generate a graph in the second tabset. I would like the graph to automatically be generated when the user clicks on the tab, as this seems much more intuitive. However, I can't figure out how to access the tab click event and use it create a graph. I would really appreciate any help/suggestions! 

Thanks,
Summer
